title: How to keep a software project in scope (and why it still runs over)

points.heading: Why projects run over: the real reasons
points.body: Scope creep gets blamed on vague requirements or indecisive clients.

points.heading: The cost of scope creep in numbers
points.body: Industry data from the Standish Group suggests that the average software project exceeds its original budget by 45% and its timeline by 50%.

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
cta.sub: Most software projects exceed their original timeline and budget.
